versions.changelog: rc.3: scan the last 14 days, confirm one route, then work it through offer, test, acquisition, delivery, cashflow review, and rerank

Initial release of the cashflow-review skill.

- Reviews a completed payable test using cash, delivery evidence, and bounded funnel metrics.
- Separates and analyzes user-provided records—only settled cash or signed obligations count; marks unverifiable sources as anecdotes.
- Calculates direct cost, gross profit, and evaluates human time and labor economics with strict evidence requirements.
- Computes funnel and retention rates only when denominators are available; avoids assumptions or fabricated data.
- Delivers standardized output: facts, reconciliation, costs, funnel rates, decision, next step, and approval checkpoint.
- Explicitly refuses requests in globally excluded lanes, ensuring lawful and ethical operation.
